full_judgment: 2. Opposite parties as plaintiff, filed Title Suit No. 428 of 1988 before the Court of Assistant Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka against the petitioners for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land. The said suit subsequently was renumbered as Title suit No. 24 of 1992 after being transferred to the Court of Additional Assistant Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka.
